classification_notes.opera_act_entries: The 15 opera.act.* rows represent avatar travel from the owning Castle room through the arrival seam into the activity and exact board return. Fixed board internals are separately represented by opera.surface.* rows.
classification_notes.coverage_scope: 64 rows are parsed-catalog coverage plus explicitly recorded supporting variants, not a claim that every future level or legacy grouped mode is exhaustive.
classification_notes.implementation_snapshot: Shared StageNavigation2D now supplies automated route, arrival, cancellation and board-return behavior for the current Opera set; Castle generic routing covers all 13 rooms, with explicit bathroom/library/playroom fixture networks. This is implementation evidence only; human geometry/device review remains pending.

rules.tap_or_drag_activation: A tap on a visible door/object or a drag toward it requests travel; action fires only after Roshan reaches the target approach point.
rules.approach_before_action: Every object action has an explicit approach_point and arrival_radius; tapping from across the room never performs the action remotely.
rules.door_arrival: A door/portal activates on tap or drag, then transitions only after arrival; cancellation and return restore the launching stage.
rules.oob: Clamp or recover to the nearest authored walk lane, clear velocity, preserve progress, and provide a voiced/picture pointer; no fail state or lost save.
rules.fixed_surface_seam: Fixed minigames may own the board interaction, but entry must be reached through the source stage and exit must return to its exact source room/coordinate.
